Edges of a ready-made bibliographic coupling network on the stagflation

Source: R/Edges_coupling.R
Edges_coupling.Rd

The bibliographic coupling edges between the documents of Nodes_coupling, computed with biblionetwork::coupling_angle(Ref_stagflation, "source_id", "target_id") (coupling angle, see build_dynamic_networks()).

Usage

Edges_coupling

Format

A data frame with 2,593 rows and 5 variables:

from

Identifier of the first document, as a character string.

to

Identifier of the second document, as a character string.

weight

Coupling angle between the two documents (see biblionetwork::coupling_angle()).

Source

Copy of from.

Target

Copy of to.

Source

Built from Ref_stagflation by inst/data-raw/creating_network_data.R.
